consumer: The external combat-log analysis script, which reads each monster's current HP integer as ground-truth numeric world state for later analysis, not asking any engine yes/no.
scope: per-monster raw current HP for each nearby/exported monster entity; not applicable beyond reading authoritative entity state
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) writes mon.get_hp() and mon.get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters into the snapshot JSON, exporting the monster's raw current hit-point integer with no display filtering or predicate evaluation
divergence: A monster the avatar cannot currently see (out of line of sight, in the dark) that is at reduced HP: the raw export must still report its true current HP integer; if a wrong answer derived the value from a display/visibility-gated path (e.g. Creature::sees) it would omit or zero the unseen monster's HP, diverging from the authoritative state.
